{"summary": "Cluster mgmt shows no critical/high vulnerabilities, but has broad cluster-admin grants and an unrestricted Argo CD project. Kubescape NSA scored 75.0 and MITRE 80.0. Remaining issues are low/medium hardening gaps (seccomp, immutable filesystem, mutable Argo revisions). Node/control-plane CIS checks were not performed.", "targets": ["mgmt"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 6, "skipped": 6, "score": 75}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 4, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD manager ServiceAccount has cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding argocd-manager (ServiceAccount kube-system/argocd-manager)", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding "argocd-manager" grants role "cluster-admin" to "ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager".", "fix": "Replace with a scoped ClusterRole: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding argocd-manager, then bind a least-privilege role covering only the resources Argo CD deploys.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD project 'platform' is fully unrestricted", "resource": "AppProject platform", "controls": [], "evidence": "Project "platform" has wildcard_destination true, wildcard_sources true and all_cluster_resources true.", "fix": "Restrict spec.destinations, spec.sourceRepos and clusterResourceWhitelist in AppProject platform to the specific namespaces, repos and kinds needed.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Argo apps use default project and floating revisions", "resource": "Applications root (project default, HEAD), alloy (project platform, main)", "controls": [], "evidence": "App "root" uses project "default" with revision "HEAD", and app "alloy" uses revision "main" in the unrestricted "platform" project.", "fix": "Move root to a dedicated restricted project and pin targetRevision to a tag or commit SHA.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters group", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding "cluster-admin" gives role "cluster-admin" to "Group:/system:masters", which looks like the Kubernetes platform default.", "fix": "No change normally; restrict who can authenticate as system:masters and avoid using it for routine access.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Pods missing Seccomp profile (PSS)", "resource": "Trivy PSS control 10 (2 workloads)", "controls": ["10"], "evidence": "Trivy PSS control "10" Seccomp failed with "fails": 2.", "fix": "securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Containers lack immutable root filesystem", "resource": "argocd/Deployment/argocd-server (+3 others)", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "Control "C-0017" Immutable container filesystem failed on 4 resources, e.g. "argocd/Deployment/argocd-server".", "fix": "securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true  # add emptyDir mounts for writable paths", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Medium vulnerabilities and low misconfigurations in images", "resource": "Trivy k8s scan of mgmt", "controls": [], "evidence": "Trivy k8s reports vuln_counts MEDIUM 8 and misconfig_counts LOW 4, with critical_high_vulns empty.", "fix": "Update affected images to latest patched versions; the digest gives no per-CVE fixed versions.", "confidence": "low"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Details of the other failed NSA/MITRE controls", "reason": "digest lists only C-0017 among failed controls although NSA shows 6 failed and MITRE 4"}]}
